question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold in the given sentence.

The incessant noise from the construction site gave her a severe headache.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Continuous.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Incessant" means continuing without any pause or interruption. Its closest synonym is "Continuous". (निरंतर)
◦ Correct: The incessant (continuous) noise from the construction site gave her a severe headache.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2 "Momentary" (very brief), Option 3 "Occasional" (happening now and then) and Option 4 "Intermittent" (starting and stopping repeatedly) are unrelated to something that goes on without any break.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of Incessant: continuous, ceaseless, constant, unremitting, perpetual, nonstop. Antonyms: intermittent, occasional, sporadic, infrequent.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Acumen (तेज़ बुद्धि): Brilliance (प्रतिभा), Intelligence (बुद्धिमत्ता), Insight (सूझबूझ), Sharpness (तीक्ष्णता)

 

2. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Frank (स्पष्ट), Honest (ईमानदार), Sincere (निष्कपट), Forthright (स्पष्टवादी)

 

3. Diligent (मेहनती): Industrious (परिश्रमी), Assiduous (अध्यवसायी), Hardworking (मेहनती), Sedulous (लगनशील)

 

4. Ephemeral (क्षणभंगुर): Transient (अस्थायी), Fleeting (क्षणिक), Momentary (पल भर का), Short-lived (अल्पकालिक)

 

5. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Thrifty (किफायती), Economical (मितव्ययी), Sparing (संयमी), Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण)

question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Abrogate
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Repeal.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Abrogate" means to formally cancel or do away with a law, agreement, or right. Its closest synonym among the options is "Repeal" (to officially revoke or cancel). (समाप्त करना)
◦ Example: The new government moved quickly to abrogate (repeal) the unpopular tax law passed by its predecessor.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Enact" means to make a bill into law — the opposite of formally cancelling one.

 

• Option 2 "Uphold" means to support or maintain something as valid — the opposite of doing away with it.

 

• Option 3 "Endorse" means to publicly approve of or support something — it has nothing to do with cancelling a law or agreement.

 

NOTE

 

• "Abrogate" is most often met in the phrase "abrogate a treaty/law" — to formally cancel or end it. Synonyms: repeal, annul, revoke, rescind, nullify, abolish. Antonyms: enact, establish, ratify, uphold.

 

5 Important Synonyms

 

1. Reticent (अल्पभाषी): Reserved (संकोची), Reluctant (अनिच्छुक), Taciturn (मितभाषी), Quiet (शांत)

 

2. Sagacious (बुद्धिमान): Wise (बुद्धिमान), Shrewd (चतुर), Astute (चतुर), Perceptive (सूक्ष्मदर्शी)

 

3. Tenacious (दृढ़): Persistent (दृढ़), Determined (निश्चयी), Steadfast (अटल), Resolute (दृढ़संकल्प)

 

4. Ubiquitous (सर्वव्यापी): Omnipresent (सर्वव्यापी), Pervasive (व्यापक), Universal (सार्वभौमिक), Widespread (व्यापक)

 

5. Vindictive (प्रतिशोधी): Vengeful (बदला लेने वाला), Spiteful (द्वेषपूर्ण), Revengeful (प्रतिशोधी), Malicious (द्वेषपूर्ण)

question:

question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Fortify
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Strengthen.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Fortify" means to strengthen something so as to protect it against attack or weakness. Its closest synonym among the options is "Strengthen" (to make stronger or more secure). (मज़बूत करना)

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Weaken" means to make something less strong — the direct opposite of reinforcing it.

 

• Option 3 "Abandon" means to give up or leave something completely — it has nothing to do with reinforcing a position.

 

• Option 4 "Undermine" means to secretly weaken or damage something over time — again the opposite of strengthening it.

• Synonyms of Fortify: strengthen, reinforce, bolster, brace, buttress, toughen. Antonyms: weaken, undermine, debilitate.

question:

solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Cripple.

◦ Example: The new regulations left small businesses hamstrung (crippled), unable to compete with larger firms.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1 "Empower" means to give someone the authority or ability to act — the opposite of severely restricting them.

 

• Option 2 "Assist" means to help someone accomplish a task — the opposite of hindering their ability to act.

 

• Option 3 "Encourage" means to give support or confidence to someone — again the opposite of crippling their ability to function.

• Synonyms of Hamstrung: crippled, disabled, incapacitated, paralysed, handicapped. Antonyms: empowered, enabled, strengthened.

question:

question:

• Option 2 "Dangerous" (likely to cause harm), Option 3 "Offensive" (causing anger or resentment) and Option 4 "Powerful" (having great strength or influence) are unrelated to something that is harmless and inoffensive.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of Innocuous: harmless, benign, innocent, inoffensive, safe. Antonyms: harmful, dangerous, offensive, noxious.

5. Robust (मजबूत): Sturdy (मजबूत), Strong (शक्तिशाली), Vigorous (ओजस्वी), Sound (दृढ़)
